testCase:
T-11: The column is off screen to the right
Goal: Find the churn risk of Northwind Traders.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/t-11/
STEP 2: Find the "Churn risk" of "Northwind Traders" (scroll the table sideways)
STEP 3: Fill "Answer" with that value
STEP 4: Click "Check answer"
STEP 5: Verify "Correct: Northwind Traders has Churn risk 34%" is visible

steps.note: Submit the case-provided value without claiming to have discovered it in the table.

args.text: Correct: Northwind Traders has Churn risk 34%

reasoning: This test checks finding an off-screen churn-risk value and submitting it correctly. The catalog cannot scroll the table sideways, so this plan only tests submission using the 34% value supplied in the expected result.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Scroll the table horizontally to locate and read Northwind Traders' off-screen Churn risk cell.
